# Purpose

Step 1 of the donor-level pseudobulk analysis of the P635 spike-specific B cell
data: read the **raw, un-normalized** counts, inspect library QC metrics, and
apply the QC cuts. Later steps build on the object saved at the end.

Two things to know about the data:

- Plate-based SMART-Seq, so one sequencing library is one sorted cell, and
  library-level RNA-seq metrics (alignment rate, coverage evenness) are
  available per cell.
- Counts come from `inputs/P635Data.Rdata` (the original `apird`
  `getGeneCounts()` pull: integer counts, 58,302 Ensembl IDs x 864 libraries).
  See `inputs/README.md` for provenance.

```{r libraries}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(annotables)   # grch38 gene annotation (Ensembl ID -> symbol, chromosome)
```

# Parameters

Everything you might want to change lives in this chunk.

```{r params}
## --- Paths -------------------------------------------------------------------
## All pipeline inputs live in inputs/ (see inputs/README.md for provenance), so
## the analysis runs from a checkout without reaching into Box.
INPUT_DIR <- "inputs"
RDATA     <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "P635Data.Rdata")
OUT_DIR   <- "pseudobulk_clean_output"

## --- QC cuts -----------------------------------------------------------------
MIN_TOTAL_READS   <- 0.5e6   # fastq_total_reads
MIN_PCT_ALIGNED   <- 70      # pct_aligned
MAX_MEDIAN_CV_COV <- 1.0     # median_cv_coverage (lower = more even coverage)

## Transcriptome composition is computed and saved for reference but not
## filtered on: among libraries passing the cuts above, the worst values are
## 13.9% mitochondrial and 426 genes detected.

dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Read raw counts

`counts` in the `.Rdata` is stored libraries-x-genes with flowcell-suffixed row
names, so it is transposed to genes-x-libraries and the names reduced to `libid`.

```{r load_counts}
env <- new.env()
load(RDATA, envir = env)          # provides: anno, metrics, counts, bcrs
cat("objects in", basename(RDATA), ":", paste(ls(env), collapse = ", "), "\n")

rawCounts <- t(as.matrix(env$counts))
colnames(rawCounts) <- str_extract(colnames(rawCounts), "lib[0-9]+")

## Sanity checks: these must hold for count-based DE downstream.
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(colnames(rawCounts)),
          all(rawCounts %% 1 == 0),        # integer counts
          min(rawCounts) >= 0)

cat(sprintf("raw counts: %d genes x %d libraries; all integer, non-negative\n",
            nrow(rawCounts), ncol(rawCounts)))
```

# Library and gene annotation

```{r annotation}
## One row per library: sample annotation joined to sequencing metrics.
libAnno <- env$anno %>%
  dplyr::select(libid, donorId, studyGroup, timePoint, sex, project,
                sort, contentType, plate, sampleWell) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    env$metrics %>%
      dplyr::select(libid, fastq_total_reads, mapped_reads, pct_aligned,
                    median_cv_coverage, percent_duplication),
    by = "libid") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    median_cv_coverage = as.numeric(median_cv_coverage),
    pct_aligned        = as.numeric(pct_aligned),
    studyGroup         = factor(studyGroup, levels = c("TC", "DS")),
    ## order donors numerically (P635-1, P635-2, ... not P635-1, P635-10)
    project = factor(project, levels = paste0("P635-", sort(as.numeric(
      str_remove(unique(project), "P635-")))))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(libid %in% colnames(rawCounts))

stopifnot(nrow(libAnno) == ncol(rawCounts))
rawCounts <- rawCounts[, libAnno$libid]     # align column order to annotation

## Gene annotation. Ensembl IDs are unversioned, so they join directly.
geneAnno <- tibble(ensgene = rownames(rawCounts)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(annotables::grch38 %>%
                     dplyr::distinct(ensgene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
                     dplyr::select(ensgene, symbol, chr, biotype),
                   by = "ensgene") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    isMito = !is.na(chr) & chr == "MT",
    isRibo = !is.na(symbol) & str_detect(symbol, "^RP[SL][0-9]"),
    isHb   = !is.na(symbol) & str_detect(symbol, "^HB[ABDEGQZ][0-9]?$"),
    isIg   = !is.na(symbol) & str_detect(symbol,
               "^IG[HKL](V|D|J|C)[0-9]|^IGH[ADEGM][0-9]?$|^IGKC$|^IGLC[0-9]$"))

cat(sprintf("annotated %d of %d genes; %d mito, %d ribosomal, %d hemoglobin, %d Ig V/D/J/C\n",
            sum(!is.na(geneAnno$symbol)), nrow(geneAnno), sum(geneAnno$isMito),
            sum(geneAnno$isRibo), sum(geneAnno$isHb), sum(geneAnno$isIg)))

kable(libAnno %>% dplyr::count(studyGroup, project, donorId, name = "nLibraries"),
      caption = "Libraries per donor")
```

# Compute QC metrics

Alignment metrics come from the pipeline; the rest are computed from the raw
count matrix.

```{r qc_metrics}
fracOf <- function(idx) Matrix::colSums(rawCounts[idx, , drop = FALSE]) /
                        Matrix::colSums(rawCounts) * 100

qc <- libAnno %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    libSize    = Matrix::colSums(rawCounts),
    nGenes     = Matrix::colSums(rawCounts > 0),
    pctMito    = fracOf(geneAnno$isMito),
    pctRibo    = fracOf(geneAnno$isRibo),
    pctHb      = fracOf(geneAnno$isHb),
    pctIg      = fracOf(geneAnno$isIg),
    pctTopGene = apply(rawCounts, 2, max) / Matrix::colSums(rawCounts) * 100)

qcVars <- c("fastq_total_reads", "pct_aligned", "median_cv_coverage",
            "percent_duplication", "libSize", "nGenes", "pctMito", "pctRibo",
            "pctHb", "pctIg", "pctTopGene")

## Distribution of every QC metric, overall and by study group.
qc %>%
  dplyr::select(studyGroup, dplyr::all_of(qcVars)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-studyGroup, names_to = "metric") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(metric, studyGroup) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(min = min(value), q25 = quantile(value, .25),
                   median = median(value), q75 = quantile(value, .75),
                   max = max(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3))) %>%
  kable(caption = "QC metric distributions by study group")
```

# QC plots

```{r plot_total_reads, fig.height=3.5}
ggplot(qc, aes(reorder(libid, fastq_total_reads), fastq_total_reads / 1e6,
               fill = studyGroup)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = MIN_TOTAL_READS / 1e6, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(TC = "steelblue", DS = "firebrick")) +
  labs(x = "library (ordered by depth)", y = "total reads (millions)",
       fill = NULL, title = "Sequencing depth per library",
       subtitle = paste0("dashed line = cut at ", MIN_TOTAL_READS / 1e6, "M reads")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank())
```

```{r plot_align_cv}
ggplot(qc, aes(median_cv_coverage, pct_aligned, colour = studyGroup)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = MIN_PCT_ALIGNED, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = MAX_MEDIAN_CV_COV, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(TC = "steelblue", DS = "firebrick")) +
  ylim(0, 100) +
  labs(x = "median CV of coverage (lower is better)", y = "percent aligned",
       colour = NULL, title = "Alignment rate vs coverage evenness",
       subtitle = "libraries in the upper-left quadrant pass") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)
```

# Apply QC cuts

```{r apply_cuts}
qc <- qc %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    passReads = fastq_total_reads  >  MIN_TOTAL_READS,
    passAlign = pct_aligned        >  MIN_PCT_ALIGNED,
    passCV    = median_cv_coverage <  MAX_MEDIAN_CV_COV,
    qcPass    = passReads & passAlign & passCV)

## How many libraries does each individual cut remove?
tibble(cut = c("total reads", "percent aligned", "median CV coverage"),
       threshold = c(paste0("> ", MIN_TOTAL_READS / 1e6, "M"),
                     paste0("> ", MIN_PCT_ALIGNED, "%"),
                     paste0("< ", MAX_MEDIAN_CV_COV)),
       nFailing = c(sum(!qc$passReads), sum(!qc$passAlign), sum(!qc$passCV))) %>%
  kable(caption = "Libraries failing each cut (cuts overlap)")

cat(sprintf("\n%d of %d libraries pass QC (%.0f%%)\n",
            sum(qc$qcPass), nrow(qc), 100 * mean(qc$qcPass)))

## Retained libraries per donor -- this is what limits pseudobulk power later.
qc %>%
  dplyr::group_by(studyGroup, project, donorId) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(nBefore = dplyr::n(), nAfter = sum(qcPass), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(studyGroup, project) %>%
  kable(caption = "Libraries per donor before and after QC")

## Failing libraries, for the record.
qc %>% dplyr::filter(!qcPass) %>%
  dplyr::select(libid, donorId, project, studyGroup, fastq_total_reads,
                pct_aligned, median_cv_coverage, nGenes, pctMito) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3))) %>%
  kable(caption = "Libraries failing QC")
```

# Save for step 2

```{r save}
countsQC <- rawCounts[, qc$libid[qc$qcPass]]
qcPassing <- qc %>% dplyr::filter(qcPass)

saveRDS(list(counts = countsQC, libAnno = qcPassing, geneAnno = geneAnno,
             params = list(MIN_TOTAL_READS = MIN_TOTAL_READS,
                           MIN_PCT_ALIGNED = MIN_PCT_ALIGNED,
                           MAX_MEDIAN_CV_COV = MAX_MEDIAN_CV_COV),
             sessionInfo = sessionInfo()),
        file.path(OUT_DIR, "step1_counts_qc.rds"))
write_csv(qc, file.path(OUT_DIR, "step1_library_qc_metrics.csv"))

cat(sprintf("saved %d genes x %d libraries to %s\n",
            nrow(countsQC), ncol(countsQC),
            file.path(OUT_DIR, "step1_counts_qc.rds")))
```

# Where this goes next

Step 2 loads the BCR calls, counts heavy and light chains, builds Supplemental
Figures S5B--S5D, removes doublets, and assigns each cell an IgH isotype. Two
things to carry over:

- The `bcrs` object inside `P635Data.Rdata` has only **8 rows** and is not
  usable. Isotype calls come from the MiXCR summary in `inputs/`.
- Doublet removal (`numheavy >= 2 | numlight >= 3`) happens there, once heavy and
  light chain counts per library are available.

The per-donor retention table above is worth a second look before going further:
donor-level pseudobulk power is set by how many cells each donor contributes to
each isotype.
